rationale: The working evaluation's concentrated limiter is the absence of evidence that laboratories will accept a third-party per-record subscription whose revenue can cover trust-heavy sales, bespoke integration, genetic-data security, and governance. The redesign moves processing into the laboratory-controlled environment, accepts only laboratory-approved events, aligns hypothesized payment with site access and completed workflows rather than every archived record, and makes an existing system vendor a prospective channel rather than claiming a direct channel or right. Published reanalysis prices evidence only the underlying paid clinical event; customer commitment, partner access, software price, savings, conversion, volume, margin, renewal, payback, and regulatory treatment remain unknown.
